test_title: PYST 42: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 30 Oct, 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined word in the context of the following sentence.

We should go to the Himalayas this __spring.__
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. **A season**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"spring"** refers to one of the four seasons in a year, typically occurring between winter and summer. It is characterized by mild weather, blooming flowers, and a renewal of nature. (बसंत)

 
 
• **Example:** Spring is the perfect time to visit gardens and enjoy the beautiful flowers in full bloom.
 
 
 
• The correct word **"spring"** in the sentence refers to the season when people often plan trips to enjoy pleasant weather. (बसंत)
 
 
• **Example:** We should go to the mountains in spring to enjoy the mild climate and scenic beauty.
 
 
 
• Hence, the word "spring" in the sentence is most appropriately understood as "a season."

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1: A water body** (जल निकाय): Refers to a natural or artificial area filled with water, such as lakes, ponds, or rivers.

 
 
• **Example:** The village is located near a spring that provides fresh water.
 
 
 
• **Option 3: Coiled metal** (घुमावदार धातु): Refers to a mechanical device made of metal that stores energy and is used in various applications.
 
 
• **Example:** The mattress is comfortable because it contains a layer of coiled metal springs.
 
 
 
• **Option 4: To jump** (कूदना): Refers to the action of leaping or hopping from one place to another.
 
 
• **Example:** The child sprang up in excitement when she saw the gift.
